name: Media
description: A fixed-ratio image container with an optional bottom gradient overlay. Used for destination photography, hero imagery and cabin photography.

evidence: Props documented; no states section (not interactive).

provenance.tag: A · unverified (4:3 and 16:9 ratios, gradient overlay), Rec (21:9, radius, objectFit)

props.name: overlay

props.name: objectFit
props.description: Photography fills the frame. Use contain for aircraft or seat diagrams.
